title: Without See Financial Data a create saves 0 prices and an edit keeps the stored prices
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop; locations Staging Heavy Duty and Staging Lethbridge). Current location Staging Heavy Duty. API replays from Chrome DevTools against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location. Logins: Admin (See Financial Data); a user without See Financial Data whose role has Part Library & Inventory View and Create & Edit. Data: QAPL-C1 (Core Charge > 0, stored Average Cost and Sell Price); the new number QAPL-NF1 (not in Inventory). Pick Category before any price field (pre-existing "Invalid UUID" otherwise; don't file).
custom_steps:
1. As Admin: Parts > Inventory > open QAPL-C1; note Average Cost, Sell Price and Core Charge; Cancel.
  2. As the user without See Financial Data: Parts > Inventory > New Inventory Part.
  3. Fill Description "QAPL non-financial create", Part Number "QAPL-NF1", Category and a default bin > Save.
  4. As the same user: open QAPL-C1 > append " NF" to the Description > Save.
  5. As Admin: open QAPL-NF1 (and replay GET /api/inventory/parts/{QAPL-NF1 id}).
  6. As Admin: open QAPL-C1.
  7. As Admin: restore QAPL-C1's description > Save; open QAPL-NF1 > Delete Part.
custom_expected:
1. Values noted; Core Charge is above 0.
  2. "New Inventory Part" shows Vendor, but no Cost, Sell Price or Core Charge field.
  3. The part is created.
  4. "Edit Inventory Part" shows Vendor but no Average Cost, Sell Price or Core Charge; the save succeeds.
  5. Average Cost 0, Sell Price 0 and Core Charge 0; the GET response agrees.
  6. The description ends " NF"; Average Cost, Sell Price and Core Charge equal the values noted in step 1.
  7. QAPL-C1's description is restored; QAPL-NF1 is deleted at once.
